titleFormatted.en: Start a temperature override on [[device]] at [[temperature]] °C for [[minutes]] minutes

hint.en: Overrides the device’s mode target for up to seven days. The device returns to its mode target when the override ends. Price and solar adjustments pause meanwhile, and so does a Smart task on the device; power limiting still applies. Running the card again replaces the override and starts the duration again. Not available while the device is set to Keep the new temperature.
